title: incident-bot: add automated on-call summaries and runbook linking
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: pass (flaky e2e initially failed, rerun passed)
release_notes: Add automated on-call shift summaries posted to Slack; Attach relevant runbook links and SLO snapshots to summaries; New incident-bot command: /oncall-summary; Backfill runbook index for quick linking; No user-visible API breaking changes.
description: Motivation: reduce on-call cognitive load and speed up handoffs by automatically generating a compact on-call summary for the current shift that includes open incidents, recent paging events, SLO snapshot, and links to the most relevant runbooks. This PR adds: 1) incident-bot command /oncall-summary that posts a structured summary to the on-call Slack channel; 2) a small slo-toolkit utility to fetch a point-in-time SLO snapshot and format it for the bot; 3) a runbook indexer that returns top runbook links given an incident title/tags; and 4) tests and CI tuning for the new end-to-end flow. The description below is a concise changelog and rationale. Implementation details: - incident-bot: new command handler (oncall_summary.py) that aggregates open incidents from the incident service, fetches a SLO snapshot from slo-toolkit via the new internal API, queries runbook-indexer for relevant runbooks, and formats a compact Slack block payload. The message includes quick actions (ack/assign) links where feasible. - slo-toolkit: added snapshot endpoint and a small CLI wrapper used by incident-bot to reduce coupling with the main eval code. - runbook-indexer: lightweight inverted-index built from docs/runbooks metadata (added a small backfill script). - Security/permissions: added minimal IAM role for incident-bot to read runbook metadata and SLO snapshot; scoped policy included in infra/roles. - Tests: unit tests for formatting and indexer ranking, integration test for the incident-bot -> slo-toolkit -> runbook-indexer flow, and an e2e smoke test that posts to a staging Slack channel (flaky runner adjusted). Backwards compatibility: existing incident-bot commands unchanged; oncall-summary is additive. Related: ENG-1823 (on-call improvements), SRE-57 (runbook discoverability).

review_comments: Marcus Reed: Nice focused change. Question: how do we ensure we don't leak internal-only runbooks to external contractors?
Aisha Patel: Add a runbook ACL check in the indexer -- runbooks with 'internal_only: true' are filtered. Policy enforced at query time. Added infra role too.
Claire Zhang: Can you make the SLO snapshot request tolerant of partial failures? We saw transient timeouts in staging.
Aisha Patel: Snapshotter now has 3s timeout + cached fallback (30m) and returns partial summary with a notice. Updated tests.
Luis Mendoza: e2e flaky on CI, failing occasionally in the Slack webhook step. Can we add a retry/backoff?
Aisha Patel: Added flake-retry wrapper and increased webhook timeout; CI pipeline updated to rerun flaky jobs once automatically.
Claire Zhang: Approving pending minor nits in comments (docs clarity).
